_doc: Sprint V16 grid, FROZEN BEFORE any experiment (committed before the first engine change is run on a zone). Model-assigned 0-5 notes are INDICATIVE ; the experimental threshold 20/25 per zone requires an explicit HUMAN visual validation : a model score alone is never a GO.

artistic_criteria_each_0_to_5.fidelity_to_reference: zone matches the geography of the reference picture (positions, contours, water bodies) : same class raster, contours not deformed to add detail
artistic_criteria_each_0_to_5.relief_and_natural_forms: progressive slopes, ridges and valleys, curved pieces on cliffs and banks, not a stack of blocks
artistic_criteria_each_0_to_5.richness_of_details: meaningful vegetation / geographic details at a density coherent with the scale and the reference
artistic_criteria_each_0_to_5.colour_harmony: natural transitions, no dominant colour, water/land differentiated
artistic_criteria_each_0_to_5.geographic_legibility: regions, mountains, forests, plains, rivers/coast readable at normal distance

artistic_total: /25 ; experimental threshold 20/25 per zone AND human visual validation

objective_measures_per_zone.class_agreement: share of the 32x32 cells whose class in the rendered top view equals the zone raster (checks the geography is untouched)
objective_measures_per_zone.block_index: share of exposed cliff edges (cell/neighbour height difference >= 2 plates) that carry NO slope or curved piece (lower = more natural)
objective_measures_per_zone.mean_height_gradient_plates_per_stud: mean |height difference| between 4-neighbours over land cells (lower = smoother)
objective_measures_per_zone.slope_and_curved_pieces: count of slope / curved / round pieces (parts 54200, 85984, 11477, 15068, 25269, 3062b, ...)
objective_measures_per_zone.detail_density: detail pieces (vegetation etc.) per 100 land cells
objective_measures_per_zone.distinct_colours: number of distinct colours in the top surface

structural_blocking_criteria_separate_fr.note: decorative leaf pieces (trees, corner rounds) are inherently one-stud : they are reported separately as `decorative_leaf`; the structural measure is `one_stud_and_carrying` and the share of non-leaf one-stud pieces. A numerical validation is NOT a physical strength proof.

baselines: ci/reference_hashes.json entries untouched ; every engine change is OFF by default and activated only by style/config keys ; the 8 CI map references must stay identical.
cycle_limit: max 3 targeted cycles per zone ; an approach that fails twice without measured gain is abandoned and documented
full_model_conditions: 3 zones improved + structural tests PASS + baselines unchanged + no new critical defect ; freezing a new reference requires explicit human validation
